rootCause: Host Rust Binder (android16-6.12 at 501f58f107ab): request_death on a node whose owner is already dead queues BR_DEAD_BINDER without marking the NodeDeath dead, so BC_CLEAR_DEATH_NOTIFICATION completes immediately and BC_DEAD_BINDER_DONE completes it a second time. libbinder drops a weak reference per BR_CLEAR_DEATH_NOTIFICATION_DONE, freeing the BpBinder under the Java BinderProxy (CE162 SIGSEGV in BinderProxy_destroy -> RefBase::decStrong).
workaround: runtime/loader/binder_runtime.h withholds the extra DONE: one per clear, never while a BR_DEAD_BINDER is unacknowledged
workload: one content query at a time on content://com.android.contacts/contacts; 3 of every 4 clients SIGKILLed mid-query; SIGUSR1 to acore after each client
